# David Glass — Re-Elect for Bastrop County Commissioner, Precinct 4

> Official campaign website for David Glass, incumbent County Commissioner for Precinct 4 in Bastrop County, Texas.

## Site Information
- **URL**: https://electdavidglass.com
- **Subject**: County Commissioner re-election campaign
- **Location**: Bastrop County, Texas
- **Office**: County Commissioner, Precinct 4

## Documentation

- [Full Campaign Narrative & Platform](https://electdavidglass.com/llm.txt): Complete biography, platform priorities, leadership history, and office contact information for David Glass.

## Pages

- [Home](https://electdavidglass.com/): Campaign landing page with overview of David Glass's leadership record, core priorities, and engagement opportunities.
- [About David Glass](https://electdavidglass.com/about): Full biography — lifelong Bastrop County resident, 40+ year business owner, rancher, and community leader. Leadership roles including President of Aqua Water Supply Corporation and Elgin Economic Development Corporation.
- [Results](https://electdavidglass.com/results): Track record of accomplishments including road projects, fiscal management, and growth stewardship across Precinct 4.
- [Core Priorities](https://electdavidglass.com/priorities): Five focus areas — Roads & Infrastructure, Responsible Growth Management, Fiscal Accountability, Water Security, and Community Preservation.
- [Precinct 4](https://electdavidglass.com/precinct-4): District information covering northern and eastern Bastrop County, including Elgin and rural communities.
- [Voter Tools](https://electdavidglass.com/voter-tools): Precinct lookup, polling location finder, early voting information, voter registration links to VoteTexas.gov, and accepted photo ID guide for Texas voters.
